metadata.agent_last_message:
- Entry point is `output/main.js:1` (Node.js stdlib only) implementing `ical parse` and `ical expand` with the required JSON schemas.
- CLI invalid-arg failures now emit the required JSON error shape (exit `1`) instead of usage text (`output/main.js:1`).
- `expand` now emits floating (no `TZID`, no trailing `Z`) and unresolved-`TZID` occurrences without a trailing `Z` (while keeping `tz` set to the unresolved TZID), and keeps resolved TZID/UTC occurrences as UTC `...Z` (`output/schema_expand.js:1`); `recurrence_id` formatting follows the same rule; `EXRULE` now emits `exrule_deprecated` warnings in `expand` too.
- Added an optional wrapper script `output/ical:1` so you can run `node output/ical parse|expand ...` as well.

Commands:
- `node output/main.js parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
- `node output/main.js expand --input <path.ics> --from <YYYY-MM-DD|...Z> --to <YYYY-MM-DD|...Z> --output <out.json>`
